method: game-clock OCR of the PCFL Network broadcast matched to the FBPro play-by-play; clips verified against the in-game result pop-ups

tennessee|texas.title: MacIntyre to Davis, 30 yards
tennessee|texas.play: The pass from Tennessee's QB George MacIntyre is caught by TE Ethan Davis for a gain of almost 30 yards. Davis is tackled by Texas's CB Kobe Black. First down, Tennessee! First and 10 to go.

tennessee|texas.title: MacIntyre fumble, January recovers
tennessee|texas.play: Tennessee's QB George MacIntyre fumbles the ball. The ball is recovered by Texas's DT Alex January. January runs for a gain of almost 5 yards. January is tackled by HB Javin Gordan. First down, Texas! First and 10 to go.

tennessee|texas.title: Game-winner: Stone 50-yard field goal
tennessee|texas.play: Texas's K Will Stone attempts a 50 yard field goal. The kick is good.

tennessee|texas.title: Fourth-down stop: MacIntyre to Thomas, 5 yards short of the sticks
tennessee|texas.play: The pass from Tennessee's QB George MacIntyre is caught by HB Star Thomas for a gain of almost 5 yards. Thomas is tackled by Texas's S Xavier Filsaime. First down, Texas! First and 10 to go.
